beats.note: It began as a C++ desktop program made by Where 2 Technologies, a small Sydney company founded in early 2003.

beats.name: Lars and Jens Rasmussen
beats.role: Designed that program, meant to be downloaded and installed separately. Google bought their company in October.

beats.text: Larry Page suggested a version for the browser.
beats.note: In Lars Rasmussen's account, the team rewrote it in HTML and JavaScript, the approach later called AJAX.
Its Earth Viewer became Google Earth in 2005, and some of its technology went into Maps.

beats.text: Google announced Maps on its blog on 8 February 2005.
beats.note: About four months after buying the company.

beats.text: Maps was an install that became a web page.
